verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs describe a guided, customizable document-generation flow (customize key terms, swap forms, customize form language) and an explicit feature to 'loop in your attorney to have them review and comment' on entered information, which aligns with the story's questionnaire+attorney-review flow. However, there's no explicit evidence of automated flagging of specific choices that need attorney review (only manual attorney invitation), and no hands-on account of the questionnaire logic itself. Missing for 10: documented automated flagging/warnings within the questionnaire, independent user account of the guided Q&A experience, and detail on how attorney-review triggers are surfaced.
